pair_intro.title: Pair the Meshtastic radio
pair_intro.description: Close the Meshtastic phone app, wake the radio, and keep its screen visible. Continuing starts one time-limited pairing request for the selected local radio.

pair_pin.description: Enter the six-digit code now shown by a RANDOM_PIN radio, or the configured fixed code for a screenless radio. The code expires shortly and is never saved by MeshNet.

remove_gateway.title: Remove a gateway
remove_gateway.description: This removes the connection from MeshNet. Bluetooth cleanup is optional and off by default. If explicitly selected, MeshNet removes only this configured radio's adapter-scoped BlueZ bond, including a pre-existing bond, so the radio can be paired again. This may disconnect other apps that use it.

data.remove_bluetooth_bond: Remove this radio's current Bluetooth bond so it can be paired again (may disconnect other apps)

maintenance.title: Automatic network maintenance
maintenance.description: Automatic maintenance is disabled by default. {eligible_gateway_count} eligible Meshtastic Bluetooth gateway(s) are available. When enabled, MeshNet waits for legitimate radio traffic to become quiet, then requests bounded NeighborInfo metadata no more than once per minute. Traffic always defers maintenance and missed runs never create a catch-up burst.

data_description.maintenance_gateway_id: Only an exact configured Meshtastic Bluetooth gateway can transmit maintenance requests.
data_description.maintenance_quiet_seconds: Allowed range: 60 to 3600 seconds. Any legitimate traffic restarts this wait.
data_description.maintenance_max_requests: Allowed range: 1 to 60. Requests remain at least 60 seconds apart.
